description: OOMKill causing 5xx errors in API service

input.alert_description: 5xx error rate exceeded 10% threshold for api-service. Current rate: 35%.
input.holmes_analysis: Datadog logs show a 5x spike in 5xx errors starting at 14:32 UTC. Kubernetes pod api-service-7b8c was OOMKilled at 14:30 UTC. Memory usage ramped from 512Mi to 2Gi over 10 minutes.

output.root_cause: The api-service pod was OOMKilled due to memory exhaustion, ramping from 512Mi to 2Gi. This caused the 5xx error spike as requests lost their serving pod.
evidence: Kubernetes pod api-service-7b8c OOMKilled at 14:30 UTC
Memory usage ramped from 512Mi to 2Gi over 10 minutes
remediation_steps: Increase memory limits for api-service pods
Add memory usage alerting with lower threshold
output.timeline: 14:20 UTC memory ramp began, 14:30 UTC OOMKill, 14:32 UTC 5xx spike

input.alert_description: Active connections reached max_connections (100). New connections are being refused.
input.holmes_analysis: PostgreSQL active connections at 100/100. payment-service holds 45 connections (normally 15). A long-running query on payments table has been running for 47 minutes.

holmes_tool_calls.result: Connection refused errors from payment-service at 09:12 UTC

output.root_cause: A long-running query on the payments table (47 minutes) blocked connection releases in payment-service, causing the connection pool to exhaust all 100 available connections.
evidence: Long-running query on payments table for 47 minutes
remediation_steps: Kill the long-running query on the payments table
Add query timeout configuration for payment-service
Increase max_connections or add connection pooling via PgBouncer
output.timeline: 08:25 UTC long-running query started, 09:12 UTC connection pool exhausted

description: SSL certificate expiry causing service unavailability

input.alert_description: SSL certificate for checkout.example.com expired 2 hours ago. Users receiving ERR_CERT_DATE_INVALID.
input.holmes_analysis: SSL certificate for checkout.example.com expired at 04:00 UTC. cert-manager logs show renewal failure: ACME challenge failed due to DNS misconfiguration.

holmes_tool_calls.result: ACME challenge failed: DNS TXT record not found

output.root_cause: The SSL certificate for checkout.example.com expired because cert-manager failed to renew it. The ACME challenge failed due to a DNS misconfiguration preventing TXT record validation.
evidence: ACME challenge failed: DNS TXT record not found
remediation_steps: Fix DNS TXT record configuration for ACME validation
Manually renew the SSL certificate as an immediate fix
output.timeline: 04:00 UTC certificate expired, 06:00 UTC alert triggered

input.alert_description: Deployment user-service-v2.3.1 stuck at 1/3 replicas ready. New pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
input.holmes_analysis: New pods for user-service-v2.3.1 crash on startup with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named redis. The Docker image was built without the redis dependency.

output.root_cause: The user-service v2.3.1 deployment fails because the Docker image is missing the redis module dependency, causing CrashLoopBackOff on startup.
evidence: Pods crash with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named redis
Docker image built without redis dependency
remediation_steps: Add redis to the Docker image dependencies and rebuild
output.timeline: 11:45 UTC deployment started, pods immediately entered CrashLoopBackOff

description: Kafka consumer lag causing delayed order processing

input.alert_description: Consumer group order-processor lag on topic orders.created exceeded 50,000 messages. Current lag: 127,000.
input.holmes_analysis: Consumer group order-processor has 3 consumers but topic has 12 partitions. Consumer throughput dropped from 5000/s to 800/s at 15:30 UTC. GC pauses averaging 2.5s on order-processor pods. Heap usage at 95%.

output.root_cause: Kafka consumer lag is caused by GC pauses (2.5s average) on order-processor pods due to heap usage at 95%. Consumer throughput dropped from 5000/s to 800/s as a result.
evidence: GC pauses averaging 2.5s on order-processor pods
remediation_steps: Increase heap size for order-processor pods
Scale order-processor consumer group to match partition count (12)
Investigate memory allocation patterns in order processing
output.timeline: 15:30 UTC throughput drop, 16:20 UTC lag exceeded threshold
